{{Top|leg}}
'''Kleck''' was a short and heavy [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] to [[Ghecharo]]. He was with him during a hunting expedition on [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. 

Against the advice of their guide, [[Kaori Batta]], they both entered an ice cave that held an injured [[modrol]]. The creature killed Ghecharo, but Batta subsequently killed it, narrowly saving Kleck's life.
